scope: 72 executable jobs for two diagonal pairs; first batch is only 18 calibration seed-31 clips. Other two pairs remain required by the full protocol.
numerical_review: Normal SLERP is an implementation baseline, not a lossless FP32 oracle; retain its documented BF16 rounding/compression. TIES preserves normal storage rounding. No tolerance is a perceptual quality threshold.

evaluation_policy.identity: Use creator references as qualitative identity anchors and matched character-only clips to isolate merge-induced change. Inspect foreground/face details across multiple visible poses, not whole-frame pixel similarity.
evaluation_policy.effect: Score intended style or exact action success separately. Identity-only preservation cannot win by discarding the effect adapter.
evaluation_policy.visibility: Report occluded, absent, out-of-frame and low-resolution subjects, with evaluable coverage. Do not silently drop missing subjects or mirror opposite turns to raise similarity.
evaluation_policy.temporal_audio: Keep temporal consistency, sound plausibility and event timing separate. Waveform energy is not a sound label; sparse frames are not full-motion review.
evaluation_policy.metrics: No validated automatic identity/AV score is implemented yet. Any future evaluator needs calibration against the available controls and must be frozen before held-out inspection.
evaluation_policy.split_limits: Both characters were already visually qualified. Held-out here means unseen prompt/seed outputs, not unseen identities. Do not fit ranking to held-out outputs.
evaluation_policy.reporting: Keep missing labels, failures, ties and per-dimension tradeoffs explicit; do not fabricate human preferences or turn tensor statistics into AV quality labels.
